test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘MARGIN’ is written as ‘NDWEEH’, and ‘SERIES’ is written as ‘THWGAM’. How will ‘LARGER’ be written in that language?
solution:
The table of alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

'MARGIN' is written as 'NDWEEH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40347de3b45578b69e14ac91ecdc0062b162b4bb6d3d1ad4ac22c361efcdda76.png] 

And,

'SERIES' is written as 'THWGAM'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bab42a1fe0a6af73252e4139c7ba685a40712913ef1df5d2339e3594624b4473.png] 

Similarly,

'LARGER' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d4e73c6f06d57f2aa279cb2cc695844cc7cbfee5771a49915bf95ad22ad870d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"MDWEAL".**
